postings.title: Senior Analog/mixed-signal IC Design Engineer - Acacia (Hybrid)
top_requirements: Design, simulate, and verify high‑speed mixed‑signal transceiver blocks (e.g., serializers, deserializers, PLLs) targeting 100 G‑400 G optical links.
Develop and characterize analog front‑end circuits (CTLE, DFE) including noise, linearity, and EVM performance across advanced‑node processes.
Collaborate with photonic integration teams to co‑design ASIC‑photonic interfaces and perform silicon bring‑up and debug.
bonus_skills: Silicon validation using high‑speed test equipment
postings.summary: Designs high‑speed mixed‑signal ICs for next‑generation fiber‑optic transceivers, a perfect match for a senior engineer with RF and modem expertise looking to stay in cutting‑edge communications ICs.

postings.title: Mixed Signal & Analog Circuit Engineer
top_requirements: Architect and design high‑speed I/O blocks such as TX drivers, PLLs, CDRs, and analog front‑ends (CTLE/DFE) for advanced‑node ASICs.
Conduct feasibility studies by benchmarking state‑of‑the‑art implementations and proposing novel circuit techniques.
Lead hands‑on silicon validation, measurement, and debugging of prototype chips.
postings.summary: A consulting‑focused mixed‑signal design role that leverages the candidate’s RF and modem background while providing exposure to a variety of high‑speed interfaces.

postings.title: AI Silicon, Analog CAD Engineer
top_requirements: Develop analog CAD models and custom design flows for ultra‑low‑power AI accelerator chips.
Create and validate analog building blocks (bias circuits, regulators, sense amplifiers) targeting 1000× efficiency gains.
Integrate analog IP into AI‑centric silicon and support silicon bring‑up and debug.
postings.summary: A role at Unconventional focused on analog IC design for AI silicon, providing a high‑impact opportunity that fits the candidate’s mixed‑signal background while moving into AI hardware.

postings.title: Mixed Signal IC Layout Designer
top_requirements: Create full‑chip physical layout for mixed‑signal IP blocks, ensuring DRC/LVS compliance and optimal floor‑plan density.
Collaborate with circuit designers to translate schematic intent into manufacturable layout with matched‑pair routing and shielding.
Develop and maintain layout‑automation scripts to improve productivity for analog/mixed‑signal designs.
postings.summary: A dedicated IC layout role that still requires deep analog knowledge, suitable for a senior engineer comfortable with hands‑on silicon implementation.
